easy.def: A thought about what to do.
easy.example: I have an idea! Let's build a fort.

more.def: A thought, plan, or picture that forms in your mind.
more.example: Her idea for the science fair was to build a tiny windmill.

easy.def: To not pay attention to something.
easy.example: Ignore the noise and keep reading.

more.def: To pay no attention to someone or something on purpose.
more.example: He ignored the ringing phone and finished his homework.

easy.def: To draw pictures for a story.
easy.example: I will illustrate my book with crayons.

more.def: To add pictures to a book or story, or to explain with examples.
more.example: The artist illustrated the story with bright watercolor paintings.

easy.def: To make a picture in your mind.
easy.example: Imagine you can fly like a bird!

more.def: To form a picture or idea in your mind of something that is not in front of you.
more.example: Try to imagine what our town looked like one hundred years ago.

easy.example: It is important to wash your hands.

more.def: Having great value or meaning; mattering a lot.
more.example: Getting enough sleep is important for staying healthy.

easy.def: Not able to happen or be done.
easy.example: It is impossible to touch the moon.

more.def: Not able to be done or to happen.
more.example: It seemed impossible to finish the puzzle, but we did it.

easy.example: I practice to improve my drawing.

more.def: To make something better or to become better.
more.example: Her reading improved after she practiced every night.

easy.def: To make someone or something a part of a group.
easy.example: Please include me in your game.

more.def: To have as a part, or to make something part of a group.
more.example: The price of the ticket includes a drink and a snack.

easy.def: A small bug with six legs.

more.def: A small animal with six legs and a body in three parts, often with wings.
more.example: Bees, ants, and butterflies are all insects.

easy.def: A thing you play to make music.

more.def: An object used to make music; also, a tool for careful work.
more.example: The violin is her favorite instrument to play.

easy.def: To stop someone when they are talking or busy.

more.def: To stop someone while they are speaking or doing something.
more.example: A loud knock interrupted the teacher in the middle of the story.

easy.def: To make something that no one has made before.
easy.example: I want to invent a robot that cleans my room.

more.def: To think of and create something new for the first time.
more.example: People invented the wheel thousands of years ago.

easy.example: I will invite my friends to my party.

more.def: To ask someone to come somewhere or to do something with you.
more.example: We invited our new neighbors over for dinner.

easy.def: Land with water all around it.
easy.example: We took a boat to the island.

more.def: A piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.
more.example: Hawaii is made up of many islands in the Pacific Ocean.
